headline: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 becomes the preferred model for Microsoft 365 Copilot, enhancing AI capabilities across popular office applications.

items.title: GPT-5.6 is now the preferred model in Microsoft 365 Copilot
items.summary: Microsoft has integrated OpenAI's GPT-5.6 as the default model for its 365 Copilot, significantly enhancing AI features in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and more. The new model promises stronger AI capabilities, enabling faster and higher-quality work outputs. Key improvements include more intelligence from every token and better performance per dollar, providing users with on-demand capabilities for complex tasks. This move positions Microsoft 365 as a frontrunner in office AI solutions.
items.why_it_matters: Tech leads should note GPT-5.6's integration as it sets a new standard for productivity tools, impacting how AI can streamline workflows in enterprise environments.

items.title: Fine-tune NVIDIA Nemotron 3 models with Amazon SageMaker AI serverless model customization
items.summary: This release enables developers to fine-tune NVIDIA Nemotron 3 models using Amazon SageMaker's serverless customization. The process is facilitated by SageMaker Studio, offering a unique architecture that supports intricate model adjustments without the overhead of managing server infrastructure, thus enhancing flexibility and ease of model deployment.

items.title: Build a semantic layer for agentic AI on AWS with Stardog and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: AWS introduces a method to construct a semantic layer using Stardog's Semantic AI Application over Amazon Aurora and Redshift. This integration with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore allows for seamless querying of customer data, facilitating comprehensive insights without traditional data extraction.

items.title: Deploying quantized models on Amazon SageMaker AI with Unsloth
items.summary: Amazon SageMaker now supports deploying quantized models using Unsloth, offering four distinct patterns for deployment. These patterns leverage Amazon EC2, providing both direct access and managed service options to optimize model deployment and performance.

all_items.summary: This post describes how Henry Schein One closed that gap by building Image Verify, an AI-powered quality verification system on Amazon SageMaker AI that evaluates dental X-ray quality at the point of capture, in real time, across thousands of locations.
